Rmd to create a survival curve for rack morts data. 

Install and load necessary packages:
```{r}
library(survival)
#install.packages("survminer")
library(survminer)
```


Read in the data:
```{r}
data <- read.csv("../data/oyster-morts.csv")
head(data)
```

Create a survival curve with these data using six different colors to represetent the 6 different oyster families (2, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10);
```{r}
fit <- survfit(Surv(date, status) ~ oyster.family, data = data)
```

make the date numeric:
```{r}
data$date <- as.numeric(data$date)
```
